priorityList: Cast Whirlwind if the Improved Whirlwind cleave buff is missing.
Use Recklessness and Avatar on cooldown, ideally together.
Cast Rampage if Enrage is about to expire or you are near Rage cap (110+ Rage).
Cast Bladestorm while Enraged, specifically when Recklessness is active.
Cast Bloodbath (Enraged Bloodthirst) as your primary builder.
Cast Execute whenever Sudden Death procs.
Cast Rampage while Recklessness is active to maximize Rage spend.
Cast Whirlwind while Recklessness is active as a high-priority filler.
Cast Bloodthirst to generate Rage or refresh Enrage.
Maintain Rend on your primary target if it has less than 6 seconds remaining.
Cast Execute on targets below 20% (or 35% with Massacre).
Cast Rampage to spend remaining Rage.
Cast Whirlwind as a general filler to maintain cleave or generate Rage.
